The traceback only shows that `train.py` exited with status 1. It omits the child process’s actual exception, so it does not establish a specific code defect.

Please provide the trial’s captured stdout/stderr, especially the traceback printed by the existing `except Exception` handler. If the failure occurred during imports, its traceback will be in stderr. No retraining is needed to retrieve existing logs.

A SEARCH/REPLACE fix without that exception would be speculative and could change the research method without resolving the failure.
